basic_details.short_information: Retired Defence Services officers with Punjab Domicile and working knowledge of Punjabi can apply for three contractual Deputy General Manager posts at the Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation (PESCO), a Punjab Government Undertaking, at a salary of basic Rs 80,000/-. Bio-data in the prescribed format must be emailed to [email protected] or sent by post or delivered at the PESCO Head Office in Chandigarh by 24 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: About PESCO
content_sections.text: The Punjab Ex-Servicemen Corporation (PESCO) is a Punjab Government Undertaking with its Head Office at SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh. According to the notice, its work includes finding employment and self-employment avenues for Ex-Servicemen, Widows and Dependents, and providing specialised manpower or security services. PESCO is also moving from a manual system to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system, which the DGM (IT) will lead.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice lists three posts, one vacancy each, all on contractual basis.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: PESCO requires medically fit retired Defence Services personnel for these posts. Working knowledge of Punjabi, Punjab Domicile and proficiency in computers are required for all appointments. An experienced retired Defence Services officer of the rank of Col/Lt Col/Maj or equivalent with good knowledge of computers as OIC/Administrator (ESM or Non-ESM). Master Degree in Computer Science, IT, Info Systems or Software Engineer. Vendor certification like SAP Certified Application Associate, Oracle / ERP Certification, Scrum Master / Agile Certifications. Experience: 5-10 years. Punjabi proficiency – 10 certificate and Punjab domicile mandatory. Preference will be given to candidates from premier Institutes like IIT, IIIT or NIT, and to ESM. An experienced retired Defence Services officer (ESM) of the rank of Lt Col/Maj or equivalent with good knowledge of computers. Background: Retired Commissioned Officers of Defence Services. Education: Post Graduate (preferably MBA or equivalent). Experience: Minimum 5 - 10 years of leadership experience. Communication: Fluent in English, Punjabi, and Hindi. Punjab Domicile and Punjabi certificate 10th Mandatory. Resident of Punjab/ Chandigarh with understanding of the Punjab industrial ecosystem is highly desirable. Open only to Ex-Servicemen. Col/Lt Col/Maj should have commanded a unit/sub unit/est or equivalent level and medically fit. The notice does not mention a separate educational qualification for this post, apart from the Punjabi, Punjab Domicile and computer proficiency required for all appointments. Age is counted as on 01 November 2026. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of each post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: All three posts carry a salary of basic Rs 80,000/-. DGM (IT) and DGM (Project & Ventures): Rs. 80,000/- per month plus allowances as approved by the Management. All three posts are on contractual basis. DGM (IT): initial contract will be for one year, extendable on annual basis on discretion of the Management. DGM (Project & Ventures): the job would require regular travel across Punjab & neighbouring states, and the officer will report to the Managing Director. DGM (IT): the officer will report directly to the Managing Director, PESCO and General Manager (Admin).

content_sections.heading: PESCO Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: PESCO intends to hire an IT Officer who will be overall in charge of the entire IT setup at PESCO, i.e. existing software in use, legacy database, cyber security and network, and ERP implementation to ensure seamless business operation. The DGM IT will be the Chief Technology Officer of PESCO, responsible for ensuring: Digital transformation of PESCO from manual to a fully automated, paperless, ERP-based system. Single Point of Contact (SPOC) between PESCO and Software Development Agency. Technical skills listed for DGM (IT): Hands-on experience with major ERP systems like SAP, Oracle, MS Dynamics 365, Ramco etc. Proficiency in database management and query language like SQL. Knowledge of coding / scripting language (Java, Python, XML). Experience connecting ERP modules with their parts applications, AIPS, cloud infrastructure etc. Ability to run system diagnostics, troubleshoot errors, data migration, backup etc. Framework knowledge of Project Management. Data Centre / Network Administrator. Network Security and Cyber Security aspects. Tableau / Data Visualisation / report generation tools. Suggest AI Tools to be incorporated in ERP / Software used. DGM (Project & Ventures) is a strategic leadership position focused on bridging the gap between the workforce of ex-servicemen (ESM)/Dependents and the evolving industrial landscape of Punjab. Job purpose: to identify, evaluate and secure new avenues for the employment and self-employment of Ex-Servicemen, Widows and Dependents, and to act as primary liaison between PESCO and the private sector, industrial bodies and skill-building agencies. Key responsibilities (Business Development & Opportunity scouting): Market Intelligence: Conduct regular market research to identify emerging sectors in Punjab/Chandigarh that can absorb ESM manpower. Tender & Project Management: Scout for government and private tenders where PESCO can provide specialized manpower or security services. Skill Gap Analysis & Liaison. Industry Mapping: Visit industrial hubs to understand specific technical and soft skill requirements. Training Partnerships: Connect with Punjab Skill Development Mission (PSDM), National Skill Development Corporation (NSDC) and private "skilling agencies" to design customized bridge courses for retiring ESM/Dependents. Curriculum Integration: Ensure that military training is mapped to civilian job roles to facilitate easier transition. Entrepreneurship Support: Identify small-scale venture opportunities for ESM. Any other responsibility given by the Management.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PESCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies: one each for DGM (IT), DGM (Project & Ventures) and DGM (Security).

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the PESCO DGM posts?
faq.answer: The last date is 24 November 2026, for bio-data sent by email or by post / physical delivery.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for PESCO DGM (IT)?
faq.answer: A Master Degree in Computer Science, IT, Info Systems or Software Engineer, with 5-10 years of experience, is required. Candidates from IIT, IIIT or NIT and ESM get preference.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for DGM (Project & Ventures)?
faq.answer: Applicants must be retired Commissioned Officers of Defence Services of rank Lt Col/Major and Post Graduate (preferably MBA or equivalent), with minimum 5 - 10 years of leadership experience.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for PESCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Ex-Servicemen must be less than 56 years as on 01 November 2026. Non-Ex-Servicemen applying for DGM (IT) must be less than 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of a PESCO DGM?
faq.answer: Each post carries a salary of basic Rs 80,000/-. For DGM (IT) and DGM (Project & Ventures), the notice says Rs. 80,000/- per month plus allowances as approved by the Management.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply for PESCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Email your bio-data in the prescribed format, with a copy of the Record of Service, PPO and photograph, to [email protected], or send it by post or deliver it at PESCO Head Office, SCO 89-90, Sector 34-A, Chandigarh - 160022.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the PESCO DGM posts?
faq.answer: Only eligible and shortlisted officers will be called for interview, and the interview date will be intimated later.

faq.question: Q9. Can Non-Ex-Servicemen apply?
faq.answer: Only for DGM (IT), which is open to Ex-Servicemen or Non-Ex-Servicemen; DGM (Project & Ventures) and DGM (Security) are for Ex-Servicemen only.

faq.question: Q10. Are the PESCO DGM posts permanent?
faq.answer: No, all three posts are on contractual basis. For DGM (IT), the initial contract will be for one year, extendable on annual basis on discretion of the Management.
